{"id":"mimid-6vsk","title":"open_direct with a deleted one-to-one room: adopt it, or an error of its own","description":"Left by bead mimid-5km1, which fixed the unrecorded case and stopped at
this one: Mark's to decide, not an agent's.

Store::reveal_direct now asks the agent for a one-to-one room with the
user that has no record here, which covers a hidden room
(Store::hide_room) and one joined but not recorded yet
(Store::accept_invite). It leaves out a room the user deleted
(Store::forget_room, State::forgotten_rooms, Tombstone::Room):
adopting it there would undo the delete.

What happens today, with the room deleted and not left:

1. Store::forget_room takes the agent, calls State::remove_room and
   leaves a Tombstone::Room. The agent stays in the MLS group, with
   both participants in the hub's room. forget_room does not want_sync.
2. Store::open_direct with that user: Store::direct_room finds nothing
   (the record is gone), Store::reveal_direct skips the room (deleted),
   and Store::host hosts a second fixed-membership room and invites the
   user.
3. The hub refuses that first Commit: crates/mimid-server/src/hub/
   update.rs fixed_rooms_elsewhere and stage_commit, room-policy-04 §5,
   \"a fixed-membership room with these participants exists already\".
   Store::host leaves the half-made room and returns
   ActionError::Agent(AgentError::Refused). The user's message fails:
   IRC through direct_for (crates/mimid-agent-irc/src/command.rs), JMAP
   as a Chat/set failure (crates/mimid-agent-jmap/src/backend.rs
   create_direct_chat).

The window is one sync long, not permanent, and the delete does not
outlive it either: Store::sync's settle_forgotten_rooms clears the
Tombstone::Room of a room the agent is active in (\"rejoined\"), and
reconcile_rooms then makes a new record for it. Store::forget_room says
so: \"A room the agent is still in is not kept out: the next sync makes
a new record for it.\" So adopting the room in open_direct would do
early what the next sync does anyway; refusing with an error of its own
would tell the user something the next sync contradicts.

The readings:

- An error of its own (ActionError, a new variant): the user is told
  their deleted room is still there and nothing is hosted. It does not
  match what the sync then does.
- Adopt it, as a hidden room is adopted: the record comes back empty
  under the new key, which is what the next sync would do, and the
  delete is undone sooner.
- Leave it to the sync (today): the user's message fails with a hub
  refusal, and succeeds after the next sync.

Whichever way, Store::forget_room of a room the agent is still in
promises less than a delete.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-28T03:01:06.271258654Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-11-28T03:01:06.271258654Z","labels":["human"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"mimid-6vsk","depends_on_id":"mimid-5km1","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-11-28T03:01:08.777384521Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}

{"notes":"DECIDED by Mark 2026-11-27: adopt it. `Store::reveal_direct` takes a one-to-one room the user deleted as well as a hidden one and one not recorded yet, clearing its `Tombstone::Room` the way the hidden case clears its tombstone.

It tells the user nothing false and changes no promise: `Store::sync`'s `settle_forgotten_rooms` revives that room anyway, because the agent is still active in it, so adopting does early exactly what the next sync does. The alternative, an error of its own, would be true for one sync interval and then contradicted by the sync.

What the user sees: writing to someone whose conversation they deleted reopens that conversation rather than failing. The delete was never durable for a room the agent is still in.

Whether a delete should be durable is a separate question, filed on its own because the spec has something to say about it."}

Adopted: Store::reveal_direct takes a one-to-one room the user deleted and clears its Tombstone::Room, so open_direct reopens it instead of hosting a second room the hub refuses. Commit ef8c9c8e; test open_direct_adopts_a_one_to_one_room_deleted_here.
